body:
Every approved move written for the game: the game moves its models by turning their parts (legs, head, tail, body), not by bending them.
- One file per move set, plus notes: timing, angles, when it plays.
- Friends see the same moves (pets sent online for real).
- Where: book tools/moves-pack/ and a note to the Plan chat.
